title: WampServer local development
summary: Local development and testing for MyAPES Account now run on WampServer instead of Laragon.
changes: The local bootstrap, dev and pre-PR options for Windows are now -Wamp and composer run dev:wamp, with a .env.wamp.example profile. WampServer's Apache serves the app at http://myapes-account.test straight from the repository's public folder.
The README, agent instructions and the developer wiki page (now Local setup (WampServer)) explain the WampServer virtual host, the hosts entry and the daily loop.
version_rationale: Patch: developer tooling and documentation only. No change to what users see or to the live app.
validation: Dev runner tests for the WampServer mode, the full PHPUnit suite and the pre-merge checks passed locally.
The local bootstrap ran in WampServer mode, and the app loaded at http://myapes-account.test through WampServer's Apache with Vite hot reload. Release history validated against main.
known_limitations: WampServer does not include a mail catcher, so local mail goes to the log unless a separate Mailpit is running.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Nothing in the database changes in this release.
provenance: Milestone v0.58.2 Dev: WampServer local development, epic #719 with sub-issue #720, pull request #721.
